test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the report of the NITI Aayog in 2023, which among the following states in India has the lowest percentage of the total population that is multidimensionally poor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the NITI Aayog report of 2023, Kerala has the lowest percentage of the total population that is multidimensionally poor.
 
• Kerala's robust health and education infrastructure contribute significantly to its low multidimensional poverty rate.
 
• The state has consistently performed well in various human development indices, including literacy and life expectancy.
 
• Kerala's social policies and investments in public services have played a crucial role in reducing poverty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)**

 
 
• The MPI is a measure that captures the multiple deprivations that people face in their daily lives, including poor health, lack of education, and inadequate living standards.
 
• It is an international measure developed by the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• The MPI assesses poverty at the individual level by considering various factors like nutrition, child mortality, years of schooling, school attendance, cooking fuel, sanitation, drinking water, electricity, housing, and assets.
 
• The MPI helps policymakers target resources and interventions more effectively to address the specific needs of the poor.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**
 
 
• NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is the premier policy think tank of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.
 
• It was established in 2015, replacing the Planning Commission of India, with the aim to foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the states on a continuous basis.
 
• NITI Aayog's primary objectives include promoting sustainable development, enhancing the use of technology, and improving governance and policy implementation.
 
• It plays a crucial role in designing strategic and long-term policies and programs for the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Human Development Index (HDI)**
 
 
• The HDI is a composite statistic of life expectancy, education, and per capita income indicators, which are used to rank countries into four tiers of human development.
 
• It is a measure of a country's social and economic development, developed by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• HDI scores are used to assess and compare the level of human development across countries and regions.
 
• The HDI helps in understanding the broader picture of development and guiding policy decisions to improve living conditions.
